author: Ari Koslow
title: Evan Phillips (elbow) to be activated Sunday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Evan Phillips will be activated on Sunday.
impact: Phillips has missed all of this season recovering from Tommy John surgery. He'll likely be eased back into a major role in the Dodgers bullpen.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Brian Fitzpatrick undergoes Tommy John surgery
desc: Brewers left-hander Brian Fitzpatrick has undergone Tommy John surgery, according to manager Pat Murphy.
impact: Fitzpatrick was removed after warming up for a June 5 relief appearance and diagnosed with a UCL sprain. After a second opinion from Dr. Keith Meister, Fitzpatrick has undergone Tommy John surgery. The southpaw posted a 1.35 ERA in five outings for the Brewers in his debut season before hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Joel Kuhnel (shoulder) dealing with "minor" impingement
desc: Brewers right-hander Joel Kuhnel (shoulder) is dealing with a "minor" impingement, according to skipper Pat Murphy.
impact: Murphy added that Kuhnel "will be okay" as he deals with a minor shoulder impingement. The 31-year-old has posted a 4.84 ERA across 35 outings between the Athletics and Brewers this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Logan Henderson (back) to make start for Brewers next week
desc: Brewers right-hander Logan Henderson (back) will make his next start for the Brewers in the team's upcoming series in St. Louis next week.
impact: Thanks to a doubleheader in St. Louis on Tuesday, the Brewers will play five games against the Cardinals next week, with Henderson expected to start one of those contests. The right-hander has been out since April 26 with a lower back issue after posting a tidy 2.74 ERA through five starts for the Crew prior to hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Shohei Ohtani (bicep) hopeful to return Sunday
desc: Dodgers right-hander/designated hitter Shohei Ohtani (bicep) felt "considerably better" on Saturday and the team is hopeful he can return Sunday, according to manager Dave Roberts.
impact: Ohtani left Friday's start against the Padres after feeling something in his bicep, and while his immediate pitching plans are unclear, Roberts is hopeful that Ohtani can get back into the starting lineup on Sunday. At the plate, Ohtani is hitting .288 with 18 homers, 60 runs, 50 RBI, six stolen bases, and a .927 OPS through 85 games this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Mike Trout (hamstring) hoping to return Tuesday
desc: Angels outfielder Mike Trout (hamstring) said he is hopeful to return as soon as Tuesday against the Rangers.
impact: Trout ran at 90-95 percent on Saturday and did not feel anything in his injured hamstring. He said he hopes to return as early as the team's next series against the Rangers on Tuesday, if not on Wednesday. The 34-year-old is enjoying another big season, hitting .234 with 17 home runs, 54 runs, 36 RBI, seven stolen bases, and an .866 OPS through 74 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Craig Yoho recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Brewers recalled Craig Yoho from Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Yoho returns to a middle-relief role as the corresponding move to Joel Kuhnel being placed on the injured list.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Chuckie Robinson optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Dodgers have optioned catcher Chuckie Robinson to Triple-A Oklahoma City.
impact: Robinson heads to the minors while the club promoted catcher Eliezer Alfonzo for his big league debut from Oklahoma City. The 31-year-old went 2-for-23 (.087) in eight games for the Dodgers prior to his demotion.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryse Wilson designated for assignment
desc: The Cubs designated Bryse Wilson for assignment.
impact: Wilson will head to waivers to make room for the signing of Jake Woodford.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: William Bergolia (shin) begins running progession
desc: White Sox infield prospect William Bergolia (shin) has begun a running progression and is hitting and throwing normally.
impact: Bergolia is on the 7-day minor league injured list with a shin contusion, but appears on track in his recovery. The 21-year-old middle infielder lacks power, but hit .457 with two stolen bases in 10 games before hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Prelander Berroa (elbow) to throw again in 1-2 weeks
desc: White Sox right-hander Prelander Berroa (elbow) will begin throwing again in the next one to two weeks.
impact: Berroa had a setback in his recovery from Tommy John surgery when he exited an ACL rehab start on May 13 after just four pitches. Originally expected to return in July, it appears an August return seems more realistic at this point.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Drew Thorpe (elbow/appendectomy) throws live BP Friday
desc: White Sox right-hander Drew Thorpe threw a live bullpen session on Friday.
impact: Thorpe's recovery from Tommy John surgery hit a speed bump when he underwent an appendectomy in May, but he has resumed throwing to the point of getting into a live bullpen session on Friday. The 25-year-old missed the entire 2025 season after posting a 5.48 ERA in nine starts in his MLB debut in the 2024 campaign.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Ky Bush (elbow) throws long toss
desc: White Sox left-hander Ky Bush (elbow) has progressed to throwing long toss.
impact: Bush had a setback in his recovery from Tommy John surgery in late May, but is seemingly getting back on track. The southpaw missed the entire 2025 season due to his elbow surgery and isn't expected to return until after the All-Star break after his setback.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jordan Romano selected by Rockies
desc: The Rockies have selected the contract of right-hander Jordan Romano from Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Romano signed with the Rockies on a minors deal in May, but has yet to appear with the big club. He struggled to a 10.13 ERA in eight outings early this season and posted a 3.72 ERA in 10 outings for the Isotopes prior to his promotion.
